# Skillglass

> Skillglass is a local desktop application for finding, reading, installing, and editing skills in approved Codex locations and folders containing SKILL.md files.

Skillglass requires no account or telemetry. It scans only approved folders, never executes imported skill content, and previews supported filesystem changes before writing. The source is planned for public release under Apache 2.0 with version 1.0.0.

- [Resumen del producto](https://skillglass.dev/es/): Spanish product page and real product sequence.

- [Releases](https://github.com/r-bart/skillglass/releases): The only planned official location for prebuilt binaries. No public binary is active yet.

- [Security policy](https://github.com/r-bart/skillglass/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and support policy.
- [Issues](https://github.com/r-bart/skillglass/issues): Product feedback and non-sensitive bug reports.

## Product facts

- Category: local desktop inventory and editor for agent skills.
- Planned packages: macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64, DEB, RPM, and Pacman x64. Final platform verification is pending the exact 1.0.0 artifacts.
- Supported inputs: approved local folders and ZIP files containing a required SKILL.md.
- Safety model: read-only discovery by default; explicit plans and diffs before writes; no privilege elevation; no imported content execution.
- Data: local SQLite index and recovery material in the application's per-user data directory.
- License: Apache License 2.0.
- Target release: 1.0.0, currently pending final validation and publication.

## Important limitations

Skillglass does not activate, deactivate, or uninstall skills. It does not crawl plugin caches automatically, decide an unobserved winner between duplicate names, install from arbitrary internet URLs, generate skills with AI, synchronize data to the cloud, or silently overwrite local changes.
